title: Gujranwala QDPS Campus, Gujranwala | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Gujranwala QDPS Campus, located in Gujranwala, Pakistan. Address: Main G.T. Road, Industrial Estate 1, Gujranwala (P.O. Box 52250). Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=32.18522231662376,74.1824166227844. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Gujranwala as the city.
